newsitem.title: UK: JKX reports Ukranian well success.
newsitem.headline: JKX reports Ukranian well success.

text.p: JKX Oil & Gas Plc on Tuesday said that a recently completed well in the Ukraine performed above expectations, generating extra oil revenues of about $1.75 million in March and April.
The well, I123 on the Ignatovskoye field, has also contributed to an increase in gas production for JKX subsidiary Poltava Petroleum Company (PPC).
PPC has started distributing gas in the Poltava region after recently being granted permission.
JKX said PPC was paid in January and February for gas supplied late in 1996, but added no subsequent payments were made.
Itera International is not presently taking gas from PPC pending clarification of its gas distribution rights in the Ukraine.
PPC is talking with Itera Ukraine and other domestic gas suppliers to agree terms for supply to the domestic market.
Negotiations are also continuing to sell gas for export.
"Further rationalisation of the gas market is under discussion in Ukraine and JKX is well positioned to participate actively in this process," said JKX chief executive officer Bob McCrackin.
